Nina R: follow-up from the observability sync: i sketched a compact provenance header we can ship to edge SDKs without blowing up payloads. want feedback on tradeoffs and rollout.
Owen B: cool. header name? length?
Nina R: propose `x-rw-prov`. two formats: small-hint and durable. small-hint = v1|flags|fp6 (48-bit fingerprint). durable = v1|flags|fp6|tok12 (12-byte truncated HMAC id). base64-encode the whole blob so it's HTTP-safe.~
Priya S: fingerprint collisions worry me. 48 bits is small but probably fine per-tenant; collisions would only affect realtime grouping, durable token fixes final billing. we should instrument collision-rate.
Owen B: what about sampling? clients may drop spans. does header still help?
Nina R: yes: header travels with request regardless of sampling. even if spans are sampled out, fp lets us attribute to a cost bucket for short-term metrics. durable token lets billing reconcile later during backfill.
Cal: backfill plan? i worry about IO and cost.
Nina R: incremental backfill: read durable tokens from write-ahead logs, join with customer attribute stream, write resolved rows to a lookup store (redis for hot, BigTable for warm). start with 7d window and hot-tenants-first. throttle per-tenant and global throughput.
Priya S: index design: use durable token as primary key -> payload {tenant, route, model, created_ts}. for fp lookup we maintain a secondary index mapping fp->list of candidate tokens (limited depth) to detect likely collisions.
Owen B: sync vs async resolution: sync lookups hurt tail. default to async + best-effort tagging. allow opt-in sync for critical billing paths. set cache TTL to 300s by default.
Nina R: security: tok12 = trunc(HMAC-KMS(tenant|ts|nonce|ver)). servers validate HMAC on resolve to prevent cross-tenant spoofing. tokens short to fit header but unforgeable.
Cal: SDK compat: older SDKs send nothing. plan?
Nina R: graceful degradation: treat absent headers as unknown attribution; prioritize durable-resolved traces in billing pipeline. migration docs + feature flags for staged rollout.
Priya S: metrics to track: percent requests with header, percent durable tokens, fp-only fraction, fp collision rate, token resolve p50/p95, cache hit rate, backfill throughput, missed-billing incidents.
Owen B: perf tests: please add a small harness for token-resolve at 1k/5k/20k rps. show p50/p95 and CPU/redis ops.
Nina R: will add perf PR. i'll also draft a tiny RFC with proto examples and a server-side lookup API (async long-poll + sync fallback).
DeployBot: Note: to run enrichment backfill, use `deploy run enrichment --tenant <id> --max-workers=8`. Monitor `ops.backfill.*` metrics.
Cal: one more: costs/TTL for lookup store. suggest auto-expire rows after 30d unless persisted by billing window.
Nina R: agreed. ok next steps: i'll open RFC + proto PR; Priya will prototype lookup table schema; Cal owns backfill playbook; Owen will add perf harness. target: pilot next sprint.
Priya S: +1.
Owen B: +1.
Nina R: thanks, everyone.
